comment: Performance benchmark scenarios (migration/BENCHMARKS.md), run by migration/scripts/bench.py. Paths are relative to migration/corpus; a null preset renders the engine's init state. Presets and MIDI are authored in generate.py (bench/). A scenario with "needs" exercises a feature the port may not have yet; bench.py still runs it, and its output-match column shows whether both engines rendered the same audio.

scenarios.name: init_single_voice
scenarios.description: Init patch (engine defaults, 2x oversampling), one held note.

scenarios.name: poly16_unison
scenarios.description: 16 held voices; oscillator 1 with 8 unison voices, oscillator 2 with 4, analog low-pass.

scenarios.name: poly32_unison
scenarios.description: 32 held voices (the maximum polyphony) on the same patch.

scenarios.name: heavy_fx
scenarios.description: 4 held voices with 4 unison voices each, through all nine effects.

scenarios.name: oversampling_1x
scenarios.description: 4 held voices, unison, ladder filter and distortion at 1x oversampling.

scenarios.name: oversampling_2x
scenarios.description: The same patch at 2x (the engine default).

scenarios.name: mod_matrix
scenarios.description: 8 held voices, two unison oscillators and both filters under 16 modulation connections.
